title: Recipe-first onboarding and a clearer guided start
summary: CloudlessOS 0.2.7-5 introduces a recipe-first first-launch experience, simplifies the interactive tour, adds permanent contextual guidance, and strengthens kiosk and runtime recovery on DGX Spark.
changes: Start every fresh CloudlessOS installation with no automatic model download or launch, and direct new users to reviewed, hardware-aware recipes in Model Manager.
Explain recipes in plain language during first launch, recommend the Laguna S 2.1 recipe on DGX Spark, and retain a direct path to the complete offline Cloudless Guide.
Replace the action-gated tutorial with a concise four-step explanation of the left tool rail and bottom shortcut shelf, using zoom-safe spotlight geometry and stable progress dots.
Preserve the left tool rail's fixed layout while it is highlighted by the tour and keep the permanent Guide shortcut accessible from the bottom-right corner.
Show one-time connection guidance after the first successful recipe launch, including the next steps for Hermes Desktop, API keys, Local network access, and Tailscale.
Keep inference deliberately unloaded after leaving a cluster instead of unexpectedly starting a local runtime.
Prevent Firefox kiosk crash recovery from entering a rapid restart loop while retaining automatic recovery from isolated browser failures.
Publish the CloudlessOS source under Apache License 2.0, move public project links to the BeCloudless-AI organization, and remove obsolete repository screenshots and hosted automation configuration.
